method: First-pass semantic audit of frozen user-facing R0/R1 outputs. Criterion-level PASS/FAIL; no lexical matching. No rerun and no training/memory update.

cases.note: R1 explicitly limits finite verification and rejects certainty outside the checked range.
Both retain confusing/inaccurate wording about the four shared-dataset papers; no clean vote-inflation warning.
Both incorrectly describe patient-level splitting as splitting each patient's data across train/test rather than separating patients.
Both misread the prompt by assigning the erroneous input table to model C instead of recognizing the common table dependency across all agents.
R1 more clearly offers a formula/parameterized route despite truncation.
Critical weakness. R0 proposes 140C/possibly C; R1 wrongly transfers revision C's 110C to revision B. B remains unresolved.
R1 correctly says actual reliability is lower but later says this causes underestimation of reliability; required consequence is overestimation by the independence model. Criterion-level regression.
Temperature shift and validation path recognized, but chemistry transfer and staged/monitored deployment are not adequately covered in truncated outputs.

reason: Mean semantic score improves, but frozen promotion gate requires critical_regressions=0. T09 contains a criterion-level regression. Independent counter-audit is still required before treating exact scores as final.
